reviewer: GPT unblinded source-context reading; not an independent world-fact verifier
scope: 8 fixed source roots, 24 actual answers per endpoint plus16 gold-history diagnostics; 120 traces read across3 endpoints

reviewed.observation: All models keep the city/topic instead of selecting region/poet/profession. The source has unknown-token artifacts; displayed requested values are recoverable from the text. No architecture cause proven.
Three-QA recovers the protagonist name where parent/first fail. It guesses a count and denies respect despite the displayed source. The name-count source question/UNKNOWN label is itself unclear.

Source describes area30627km2 and share5percent, but targets add a year unit and use an item-count suffix. A GOLD-history literal match to that suffix is not content correctness. Models also answer wrong quantities/topics.

Three-QA extracts the stated cause but produces year2014 instead of source2013 and age88 instead of87. These are answer selection/copy errors against the supplied reference, not evidence of an arithmetic or floating-point implementation bug.

Parent/first repeat the topic rather than settlers or historical event. Three-QA changes the answer but invents unsupported event/wording. The final target requires computing a duration, which is a different capability from copying a name.
Three-QA gets the negative follow-up but answers end-of-day against morning and fails lake-shore destination. Other models repeat the drum sentence rather than the requested time.

Parent first answer is semantically supported despite literal0 because it includes a full sentence. First-QA retrieves age11; three-QA retrieves April but chooses the girl's age12 for the boy and a number for a grade. Subject/attribute selection remains weak.

Boy/girl names are confused and weather negated against the reference. Jessica versus Jessica. is a punctuation-only target mismatch in some second-turn answers; do not count every literal0 as a content error.

limitations: not a population defect rate or unbiased semantic accuracy estimate
